featured_reviews.review_text:
The food here is truly amazing! I tried the Rs. 90/- Thali, and it was delicious. What I loved most was the vibe—the ambience is incredibly peaceful and beautiful. The staff was very polite, and the service was quick. It’s a perfect spot to visit with friends and family. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Narendra Bhuwalka
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello when you get stuck for work outside your home and when you are at Bhayandar the best restaurant which comes to your rescue if you have to stay overnight is none other than @karmatheeaterylawn in this restaurant it gets open at 4:00 p.m. in the evening and is operational till 4 a.m. in the morning they have some great decor this place the walls are made with bamboo and the ceiling is made with jute...

Also they have got some great Ambience and some wonderful customer service experience which we had when we visited there they only serve vegetarian food they also had some great mocktails to offer and currently they are giving 15% discount on bills today because of Independence Day...

They do have live music to our rescue this will definitely help you to destress yourself and also make sure you will enjoy there wonderful service in the form of Sheesha & also this restaurant currently have some great vegetarian food from wonderful starters, main course and last but not the least there mocktails are to die for for me one of the top dishes I would recommend again the pepper corn & Chana Koliwada was again top notch I have never had such tasty, natural & healthy starters anytime...

#midnightcravings #karmatheeaterylawn #uttan #bhayanderwest #vegetarian #mocktails #yummyfood #starters #livemusic #ambiance #seesha #familyrestaurant #corporateparties

featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant & bar. From the moment we entered, the ambiance felt warm and inviting. The lighting, music, and seating arrangement created a perfect balance between comfort and premium vibes. It’s suitable for both family dinners and evening hangouts with friends.
The food quality was impressive. Starters were fresh and well-seasoned, and the presentation looked professional. The main course was flavorful with generous portion sizes. You can clearly feel that they use good quality ingredients.
The bar section is well-managed with a wide variety of drinks and cocktails. The bartender knows his craft – our drinks were perfectly balanced, not too strong, not too light.
Service was quick and staff members were polite and attentive. They regularly checked if everything was fine without being intrusive. Overall, a place worth revisiting.

featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited this small restaurant and was truly impressed. The food quality is excellent, and every dish tastes delicious and fresh. featured_reviews.name: Sunil D'Silva
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a small cosy village old-school home converted into a live kitchen which serves simply yet delicious seafood at a very nominal cost. The ladies who run the place are very kind and will answer all your questions peacefully while they are busy cooking. They serve mainly pomfret, bombil, tarli, ravas, manli and prawns fry and also ambotik and other fish curries. They also serve Chicken kheema and chicken curry and a few local vegetables. These can be accompanied by their famous rice bhakari or chapatis all made in-house. A must visit to pick food or even eat at the place if your looking for authentic village yummy food.

featured_reviews.review_text: Nice place, not crowded. Peaceful and relaxing.  But beware DO NOT enter or go near the wash room.  Beware, don’t say I didn’t warn you coz you will faint when you enter the washroom.  It stinks like hell. Also, food quality was average - like the Biryani was sweet. I mean who eats sweet biryani with kewda flavour.and the raita had more water than curd in it (yuck).  No one ate it.  Also, most of the dishes taste the same. We ordered almost 20 varieties from their menu and they all tasted the same.  Even the fish tasted the same like chicken. Table service is like waiting for ages. featured_reviews.name: Rais Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the worst dining experiences I’ve ever had!

1. AC Issue:
From the moment we entered, the AC wasn’t working properly. Despite complaining multiple times, the staff kept giving excuses like “abhi thoda time do, abhi hawa aayegi, abhi chalu ho jaayega.” The truth is, it never worked and we had to sit uncomfortably throughout.

2. Expired Dessert:
We ordered a chocolate brownie thinking at least dessert would make up for it. Shockingly, the brownie was expired and spoiled. Just one spoon was enough to feel like vomiting. When we complained, instead of accepting the mistake, the waiter himself tasted it and gave us a fake expression pretending that it was fine.

3. Unprofessional Behavior:
When we asked for the bill, they shamelessly included the charges for that spoiled brownie. We told them that we didn’t eat it and it was their fault, not ours. But they argued, saying:

“Aapko pasand nahi aaya toh aapka problem hai, brownie theek hai.”

“Agar hum new brownie denge aur aapko phir bhi acha nahi laga toh hamara maal waste ho jaayega.”

This shows a complete lack of customer respect. Instead of apologising or replacing the item, they forced us to pay for something that was clearly inedible.This was my last experience in this midtown restaurant never going to visit in this restaurant and request everyone to never visit this restaurant very very poor quality of food.

featured_reviews.name: Shrey Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve never experienced such shocking pricing and careless customer communication at any restaurant before. We were charged ₹300 for ONE Red Bull — nearly 200 times the normal price. We ordered four, and the bill came to ₹1200 just for Red Bull, which is absolutely unreasonable.

What makes it worse is that the staff specifically came to inform us about extra charges for crisps and schezwan sauce, yet never mentioned anything about the excessively inflated Red Bull price. This selective communication feels extremely misleading.

When we brought this up with the owner, his response was simply that “this is the price we offer” — showing zero concern, zero transparency, and zero accountability. The complete lack of responsibility from management was honestly embarrassing for a place that expects customers to pay such prices.

featured_reviews.name: Gagan Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
This restaurant is situated on Uttan Road in Mira Bhayandar. This this place is little away from main road as result You will find this place less noisy and crowded also. I will suggest you to go by own vehicle ans you will not get auto from here at night.

I visited this restaurant for my best friend's birthday part last Sunday. Restaurant has very good, calm and peaceful ambience along with Live Ghazal. This place was less crowded and seating is also comfortable.

Food is also tasty and delicious. We ordered Chicken Lollypop, Chicken Pahadi Kabab, Paneer Koliwada, Paneer crispy, Murg Mussallam etc. All dishes were tasty and delicious. No complaints about food.

Staff is not at all friendly and helpful. The service is not 1% good at all. If I had option for zero or Minus star, I would have given that. Place was not crowded even though order got delayed. All orders served after 30-45 mins. Bill was the only thing which we received on Time.

Suggestion - Try to fasten the service.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent food & service – highly recommended!
Kababination Restaurant truly impressed us with their delicious food, great taste, and excellent hygiene standards. The service was top-notch, and the staff is very genuine, polite, and knowledgeable about the menu and catering requirements.
They do not compromise at all on taste or quality. We had given a society pooja catering order and every single person loved the food. Everything was perfectly prepared, but the Sitaphal Basundi was outstanding and became everyone’s favorite.

Overall, a wonderful experience. I would definitely recommend everyone to order food from Kababination for both regular dining and catering needs.

This is quite a descent and pocket friendly place..located near by bhayandar west (approximately 4 km from bhayandar flyover for people whom don't know about locality)
Special thing is that they've build huts for individuals or group depends on the capacity of the group.....as I said place is affordable so good to go for family dinner..food is also delicious..try fish items here because it's near by the gorai and uttan beach so you'll get fresh fish and for vegetarians go for paneer it's quite good...we tried paneer on top properly cooked and taste was good..little delay as it's always crowded..so if you wanna go for huts come early.
